|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[Moff Gideon, Suited For Battle]] (version 2 of 2). Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). * '''PC-E1''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata (Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf)<ref name="sheet23-20240802">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 9 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file created 2 August 2024). If you just deployed Darksaber here, may take any one card into hand from Used Pile; reshuffle. You initiate battles here for free. Your total battle destiny here is +1. Immune to attrition &lt; 3.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Moff Gideon, Suited For Battle]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Moff Gideon, Suited For Battle]] (published 21 July 2024) as a printable slip under the label “•Moff Gideon, Suited For Battle”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings).
